Keeper aisle 1 (parts/room-1.mjs) is built: a dark_oak_planks beam along the ceiling at y 12, z 3, x 4..11, with two hanging lanterns at (6,11,3) and (10,11,3). Plain brick and no other furniture, as the room spec says.
`mcd room --only "keeper aisle 1"` says OK: 16/16 floor cells reachable, min light 8, mean 9.5, 0 dark.
make.sh finished with a whole build.nbt; the part shows 10 placed, 0 refused, no off-palette blocks.
left: The L-shaped extension of the keeper aisle in plan.md (x 9..11, z 5..8) is outside rooms.json's box [4,7,3,11,12,4], so I did not build it; the brief said build inside the box only.
No focal piece beyond the beam and lanterns, because the room spec says no furniture beyond a lantern. If the designer wants a focal piece, it needs a decision.
